SITE TERMS OF USE 
 
Overview 
  
This Site Terms of Use should be read in conjunction to the Privacy Policy, Credit Report 
Terms of Use and Disclaimers of the Site and shall collectively be referred to as 
“Agreement” between the User and BHFL.  
  
This document (“Site Terms of Use”) is published in compliance with the provisions 
of Information Technology Act, 2000 (as amended from time to time) and all other 
Applicable Laws, Guidelines, Rules & Regulations.  
  
In this policy, 
1. "Affiliates" means, in relation to any person, any entity that directly or indirectly 
controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with, the person, where the 
term ‘control’ shall have the meaning assigned to it in the Companies Act, 2013, as 
amended from time to time. 
2. "Applicable Laws" includes any applicable constitution, statute, law, rule, 
regulation, ordinance, decree, order, judgement, authorization, or any directive, 
guideline, requirement or government restriction having the force of law, or any 
determination by, or interpretation of any of the foregoing by, any judicial 
authority, whether in effect as of the date of the Agreement  or thereafter and each 
as amended from time to time within the jurisdiction of India. 
3. "Bureau” shall mean credit information company which is authorized under 
Applicable Laws of India to provide comprehensive credit information by 
collecting, collating, and issuing credit information, pertaining to both commercial 
and consumer borrowers, to a closed User group of members. In relation to 
provision of the Services mentioned herein. “Credit Report Terms of Use” shall 
mean the terms of use, pertaining to the credit information company and relevant 
terms of the Site, for enjoying the Services of availing the credit report as offered 
on the Site. Such Credit Report Terms of Use shall always be read with Site Terms 
of Use, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers of the Site. 
4. “Partner” means banks, nonbanking financial institutions, housing finance 
companies, insurance companies, fintech companies, Bureau and such other 
financial institutions which are regulated by RBI, SEBI, IRDA either directly or 
indirectly etc. whereas BHFL has an arrangement with them for offering their 
products on the Site.   
5. “Site” means any web site, mobile site, or application, owned, and operated by us. 
6. “Service” means using our products, software, services, as available on our Site 
and any products offered by our Partner’s on our Site. 
7. “Service Provider” means any authorized Service Provider engaged by BHFL 
thereby enabling us to offer Services on Site. 
8. “We,” “us,” and “our” means Bajaj Housing Finance Limited (“BHFL”). 
9. "I", “You” and “your” “User” mean anyone who visits, accesses, or uses our Site or 
obtains Services from us through our Site. 
  
The Services rendered by BHFL are exclusively intended for individuals who are citizens 
of India and residing in India and are above 18 years of age. By accessing our Site and/or 
using the information provided on or via this Site, you agree to the following terms of use.

If you do not agree with the terms and use stated hereunder, you shall not access, visit 
and/or use the Site and avail our Service. 
 
User Declaration 
By using this Site, you confirm that you are a resident of India and have attained the age 
of at least 18 years, and you are legally entitled to enter into a binding contract and that 
you are not a person barred from receiving Services under the Applicable Laws of India 
and will only use the Site to make legitimate transactions for you or for another person for 
whom you are legally authorized to act (and will inform such other persons about the Site 
Terms of Use, Credit Report Terms of Use and Privacy Policy) that apply to the interactions 
you have made on their behalf (including all rules and restrictions applicable thereto). You 
also confirm that the statements, answers and/ or information given by you are true and 
complete in all respects and that you are authorized to avail the Services on behalf of 
other person(s). 
  
You agree that if you undertake any financial transaction through the Site, BHFL will 
conduct due diligence and seek mandatory information required for KYC purpose; and as 
a User you hereby authorise BHFL to facilitate your transaction in accordance with the 
Applicable Laws in India. 
  
While using the Site to communicate with BHFL, you shall communicate with your 
registered mobile/telephone number and/or e-mail address. Thereby, you agree to 
receive communication from BHFL on your registered mobile/telephone number and/or 
e-mail address. 
  
Notwithstanding whether your telephone/mobile is registered with NCPR/NDNC 
maintained by TRAI, by accessing this Site, you, by applying/enquiring/verifying any of 
the Services offered on the Site and or you are making a request to call back, it is deemed 
that you have expressly authorized BHFL, Partners and Service Providers of BHFL to call 
back or send you text messages or messages through chatbots for solicitation and 
procurement of Services. In case if you may not wish to receive any calls/messages, you 
are obliged to proactively inform BHFL about the same. 
  
While using this Site, you agree NOT to, by any means indulge in illegal or unauthorized 
activities including but not limited to (i) use the Site for unlawful purposes; (ii) collect 
information about the Users without their express consent; (iii) engage in spamming or 
flooding; (iv) transmit any software or other materials that contain any virus or other 
harmful or disruptive component; (v) remove any copyright, trademark or other 
proprietary rights contained in the Site; (vi) copy, mirror any part of the Site without our 
prior permission; (vii) permit or help anyone without access to use the Site through your 
Username and password or otherwise; and (viii) posting any defamatory messages to 
either in print/electronic/social media; (ix) impersonate any person or entity, falsely claim 
an affiliation with any person or entity, or access the accounts of others without 
permission, forge/fabricate another persons’ digital signature, misrepresent the source, 
identity, or content of information transmitted via the Site, perform any other similar 
fraudulent activity or otherwise send or receive what BHFL reasonably believes to be 
potentially fraudulent funds; (x) infringe BHFL, its Partner’s or Service Provider or any 
third party’s intellectual property rights, rights of publicity or rights of privacy; (xi) use any 
robot, spider, other automatic device, or manual process to monitor or copy the Site 
without prior written permission; (xii) use any device, software or routine to bypass Site 
exclusion headers, or interfere or attempt to interfere, with the Site; (xiii) remove, 
circumvent, disable, damage or otherwise interfere with security-related features of the 
Site or features that enforce limitations on the use of the Site; (xiv) reverse engineer,

decompile, disassemble or otherwise attempt to discover the source code of the Site or 
any part thereof; (xv) use the Site in any manner that could damage, disable, overburden, 
or impair it, including but not limited to using Site in an automated manner; (xvi) 
intentionally interfere with or damage operation of the Site or any User’s enjoyment of 
them, by any means, including but not limited to uploading or otherwise disseminating 
viruses, adware, spyware, worms, or other malicious code. (xvii) You agree and authorize 
BHFL to share your information, with its, Partners, Service Providers and other third 
parties, in so far as required for marketing purposes/offering/cross-selling various 
products and Services and/or to provide you with various value-added services, in 
association with the Services selected by you or generally otherwise. (xviii) If you request 
not to receive such communication/marketing material any further from us, it shall be 
applicable prospectively only and shall not apply in respect to your data already shared 
by us with its Partnerss, Service Providers and third parties. In case you do not wish to 
receive any such communication/marketing materials from our Partner, you agree to get 
in touch with them independently, without involving us. (xix) you voluntarily consent to 
register as a member of BHFL community to get personalized and exclusive products, 
offers and services from BHFL in tie up with its business Partners for meeting your 
financial needs while you access any Products or Services on Site. 
  
By accessing the Site: 
  
(i) you acknowledge that BHFL vide its Site operates as a digital platform, offering 
financial products through its Partners. 
  
(ii) you understand that you would be required to share and suBHFLit personal identifiable 
information and sensitive personal information [collectively referred as “Personal

Information shall be governed by the Privacy Policy as updated on the Site. 
  
(iii) you affirm that all information provided by you are correct, complete, and up-to-date 
and no information has been withheld by you and you shall keep BHFL and Partners, 
informed of any change in the information provided by you. 
  
(iv) you authorize BHFL to share your information with its respective Partners and Service 
Providers, in connection with the financial product chosen by you. 
  
(v) you agree that you shall be contacted by BHFL, its Partners, Service Providers, vide 
email, SMS, phone call, WhatsApp or any other mode of communication as 
provided/available in relation with my loan/credit card application , insurance, investment

accept the terms of use, such consent by you, irrespective of any registration by you with

(NCPR) under TRAI. 
  
(vi) you authorize BHFL and its Partners to share all information provided by you or 
obtained as a result of your application for such financial product selected by you with 
other third parties, including but not limited to, Service Providers, Bureaus, statutory

its affiliates, group companies or its Partners liable, for use/sharing of the information as 
mentioned above.

(vii) you confirm that you have read the terms and conditions, , as applicable for all 
financial products which you wish to avail, including, applicable fees and changes, if any 
and as available on this Site or as disclosed by the Partner. 
  
(viii) you acknowledge that you shall be required to accept the terms of loan/credit

Partner however, while you may be filling up the application for such loan/credit

and assign credit limit etc. and BHFL holds no warranty and does not make any 
representation or commitment of approval/rejection of my loan/credit card 
application/insurance/financial products in any manner whatsoever. 
  
(ix) you agree that all interest rates, prices etc. shown on the Site may vary and interest 
rates, charges, fees, prices and all such terms and conditions shall be determined by the 
Partner whereas, EMI calculators are provided on the Site are only as self-help planning 
tools and the same may be subject to errors, omissions and therefore you must verify the 
results at your end before concluding and therefore, BHFL does not guarantee its 
accuracy or applicability. 
  
(x) you acknowledge that based on your previous relationship with BHFL or its Partners, 
you may be shown pre-qualified/pre-approved offer from time to time, however no pre-
qualified/pre-approved offer shall constitute any commitment/guarantee of any financial 
product being offered to you. 
  
(xi) you agree that any decision to apply for any financial product is solely at your own risk 
and you will hold BHFL harmless for any loss or damage that you may suffer, whether 
directly or indirectly. 
  
(xii) you hereby consent and authorize BHFL, to send communications in relation to 
customized recommendations, promotional offers, information on various other products 
and Services available on this Site by BHFL via email, SMS, WhatsApp, phone call, App 
notifications or any other means of communication even if you have registered under 
NCPR/NDNC or any other registry prescribed by Telecom Regulatory Authority of India 
(TRAI) from time to time. 
  
(xiii) You agree that display of financial products, offered by Partners on the Site, does not 
in any way imply, suggest, or constitute any sponsorship, recommendation, opinion, 
advice or approval of BHFL in favour/against any Partner or their products. You agree that 
BHFL is in no way responsible for the accuracy, timeliness or completeness of information

(xiv) Your interaction with any Partner accessed through the Site is at your own risk, and 
BHFL will have no liability with respect to the acts, omissions, errors, representations, 
warranties, breaches or negligence of any Partner or for any personal injuries, death, 
property damage, or other damages or expenses resulting from your interactions with 
such Partners and Service Providers. 
  
  
(xvi) you authorize BHFL to obtain your information from financial information providers 
via account aggregator platform for providing Services to you on Site. This consent by 
you shall be valid upto a period of 24 months, unless otherwise revoked by you

(xvii) You agree that display of the financial products and any related offers including but 
not limited to the pre-approved/pre-qualified offers, quick loans or such other 
representation/banners that are offered by Partners on the Site, are based on the terms 
and conditions of the respective Partners and (xviii) You may be redirected to Partner’s 
digital property, based on the type of Services you may choose to avail. 
  
(xviii) You agree that You shall be redirected to the digital property of registered Account 
Aggregators, for completing the requisite formalities and you shall be bound by the terms 
and conditions as applicable of such Account Aggregator. You hereby give consent and 
authorise BHFL to fetch your Financial Information as defined under the Master 
Directions-Non-Banking Financial Company - Account Aggregator (Reserve Bank) 
Directions 2016 from various FIPs (“Financial Information Provider”) on a periodic basis, 
for the purpose of providing PFM. The PFM offered by BHFL, analyses your transactions 
directly or through its Service Providers and provides you a PFM summary report from 
time to time on the Site. You expressly disclaim BHFL from any liability towards the

and nothing contained in this summary report shall be deemed as professional advice or 
solicitation. The PFM offered through the BHFL Platform does not constitute investment 
advice or advice of any nature. 
  
(xix)  
User acknowledges that communications or responses provided during interactions on 
our Site may be generated or facilitated by "ServeEase", a Generative Artificial 
Intelligence (GenAI) powered chatbot designed to assist users with information, 
recommendations, and selected documents related to his loan processing. 
ServeEase generates responses based on available data, programmed instructions, and 
knowledgebase with defined guardrails. While reasonable efforts are made to provide 
accurate and helpful information, responses may occasionally be inaccurate, incomplete, 
or may not reflect the latest legal, regulatory, product, or policy updates. 
Users should independently verify information that may affect financial, legal, tax, or

Responses generated by ServeEase are provided subject to the limitations inherent in AI

ServeEase does not make lending, underwriting, credit approval, risk assessment, or
